source_name: MNB Archívum – Felügyelt intézmények (legacy PSZÁF-era pages)
why_relevant: Legacy archive of the pre-2013 supervisory site (PSZÁF heritage). Useful for historical institution lists and decisions that predate the current portal and for resolving entities that no longer exist.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Tagjaink (member institutions directory)
why_relevant: Curated register of ~67 Hungarian credit institutions, mortgage banks, guarantee funds plus associated members/observers (Társult tagok, Megfigyelők). Each entry links to a per-member detail page (tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=N) carrying the institution's own site — the single best seed for enumerating every bank-level disclosure/IR source in HU.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Munkacsoportok (working groups)
why_relevant: Working-group structure reveals which topics the sector is actively organising around (payments, digitalisation, compliance/AML, lending) and typically names the member banks and individuals leading each — a map of decision-makers and of live sector agenda items.

source_name: Nemzeti Cégtár / OPTEN company profiles (GIRO Zrt.)
why_relevant: Commercial company-registry aggregators giving ownership, registration number (e.g. GIRO cg. 01-10-041159 / id e10478384), officers and filed financial summaries — useful for confirming legal identity and ownership chains of the infrastructure operators before pulling their reports.

entity_name: Céginformációs és az Elektronikus Cégeljárásban Közreműködő Szolgálat
source_name: Céginformációs és az Elektronikus Cégeljárásban Közreműködő Szolgálat (Céginformációs Szolgálat)
why_relevant: The state body that receives filings and defines what company information is public and how it is obtained (free vs. paid, OBR submission route). Its pages are the authoritative map of the Hungarian filing infrastructure and link onward to e-beszámoló, Cégközlöny and e-cégjegyzék.

entity_name: Céginformációs és az Elektronikus Cégeljárásban Közreműködő Szolgálat
source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat - beszámoló állomány értékesítése (bulk accounts dataset sale)
why_relevant: Official channel to license the full filed-accounts corpus in bulk rather than scraping e-beszamolo one company at a time - the legally clean path to systematic auditor-opinion coverage across all Hungarian credit and payment institutions.

source_name: Magyar Fintech Szövetség (HFA) – Tagok (member companies)
why_relevant: The only curated register of the Hungarian fintech ecosystem (startups through mature vendors, incubators, accelerators). Founding/board members observed include Barion, Tőkeportál, BlockBen, Ergománia, Bankmonitor, BÁV Faktor, Blueopes, Flexibill, Péntech, TechTeamer. Seeds dozens of PSP/vendor sources no keyword search surfaces.

source_name: MFB Csoport member-company map (MFB bankcsoport pages + Wikipedia MFB Csoport)
why_relevant: Enumerates the state financial group's members (Hiventures, Diákhitel Központ, Magyar Követeléskezelő, MFB Ingatlanfejlesztő, Garantiqa, Eximbank relationships), each of which files its own annual accounts. Turns one actor into a dozen collectible reporting entities.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal / BRIS - Find a company
why_relevant: EU-level federated search across national business registers including Hungary's, exposing EUID-keyed records, branch and cross-border merger information in English. It is the canonical cross-border entry point that translates Hungarian register data for non-Hungarian users and documents exactly which HU company forms are in scope.

source_name: Kosárértek.hu – Hungarian e-commerce trade portal, PSP company directory
why_relevant: E-commerce industry portal maintaining company profiles of payment providers serving Hungarian webshops. Useful for enumerating the gateway/PSP long tail (including Netpincér-adjacent and webshop-focused providers) that regulator registers list only under opaque legal names.

source_name: AmCham Hungary – Membership Directory (financial services members)
why_relevant: Bilingual member directory with per-company profile pages for banks operating in Hungary (OTP Bank, K&H Bank, ING Bank N.V. Hungary Branch, Deutsche Bank Hungarian Branch observed). Adds branch-office and foreign-parent entities that domestic associations under-represent, and AmCham committees/Board pages map senior financial-sector executives.

source_name: ATM Marketplace – vendor company showcases (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, Auriga)
why_relevant: Trade-press aggregator holding per-vendor showcase pages, product sheets and news; a compact index for discovering additional self-service vendors and their case studies, including ones with CEE footprints not visible on their own sites.

source_name: Banktech Safe Kft. – banktech.hu (self-service kiosk / cash-handling distributor)
why_relevant: Positions itself as a leading domestic distributor of banking technology: safes, automated cash tills, kiosks, cash counting/authentication, access control. Its product and partner pages map which foreign cash-handling brands reach the HU market and through whom.

source_name: DBM Kft. – banktechnika / biztonságtechnika integrator
why_relevant: 30+ year Hungarian integrator covering banking technology and security technology for branch environments; reference/partner pages indicate which banks it equips and which OEM brands it represents.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf – Banking Case Studies hub
why_relevant: Vendor-published customer case studies naming specific banks and their self-service/outsourcing decisions; CEE examples (e.g. CSOB) show the format. Each case study is itself a pointer to a bank-side source and to contract scope (fleet size, managed services).

source_name: European Banking Federation – national member associations directory
why_relevant: EBF unites 33 national banking associations representing ~3,500 banks; the Hungarian Banking Association is the HU member (Levente Kovács named as its Secretary General in EBF contexts). Useful for cross-country benchmarking of HU against peer associations and for EN-language framing of HU sector positions.

source_name: European Payments Council – list of member organisations
why_relevant: Enumerates national payment-scheme participants and associations across Europe; the payments-specific counterpart to the EBF list and a route to identifying which HU institutions/associations sit in SEPA and instant-payment scheme governance.

source_name: FeaturedCustomers – Diebold Nixdorf reference/review profile
why_relevant: Third-party aggregation of named customer references and testimonials for the vendor; useful to discover bank names that the vendor's own site does not surface, then to snowball back to the bank's own reporting.

source_name: HVCA – Magyar Kockázati- és Magántőke Egyesület, Tagok
why_relevant: ~70 members (28 full, 32 associate, 10 individual) categorised by role, incl. an /tagok/category/investors view. Identifies the capital behind Hungarian fintechs and the PE/VC owners that drive consolidation among payment and lending firms; the 30-year jubilee yearbook adds historical deal context.

source_name: K-Monitor adatbázis – MFB and state-lender public-spending / contract records
why_relevant: NGO-curated archive linking state-owned financial institutions to public-money, contract and governance reporting. Reveals-indirectly category: surfaces procurement and vendor relationships around MFB and peers that never appear in the annual report narrative.

source_name: Magyar Könyvvizsgálói Kamara (MKVK) - chamber register, transparency-report rules and committee communiqués
why_relevant: Chamber of Hungarian Auditors: registry of audit firms and members, and the legal framework requiring audit firms serving public-interest entities to publish an annual atlathatosagi jelentes (transparency report) on their own websites within 3 months of year-end. Pointer to per-firm transparency reports and to who may audit banks.

source_name: MAKISZ – Magyar Követeléskezelők és Üzleti Információt Szolgáltatók Szövetsége
why_relevant: Debt-purchase and business-information association; ~41 members reported purchasing ~HUF 320bn of receivables (2020) and managing ~HUF 500bn. Enumerates the receivables-management and credit-bureau vendor set that sits downstream of every bank and leasing house, and runs sector conferences (e.g. on leasing-portfolio collections).

source_name: TheBanks.eu - Major Banks of Hungary (third-party bank register with rating fields)
why_relevant: Compact aggregator listing Hungarian banks by total assets/market share alongside which agency rates each entity and at what level (e.g. MBH Baa2 Moody's / NR Fitch). Useful as the seed entity list telling the collector which banks are rated by whom, and which are rated by nobody.

source_name: Vállalkozz digitálisan (MKIK) supplier directory – payment providers
why_relevant: Chamber-of-commerce accredited-supplier directory listing payment providers (Barion among them) with legal identifiers. A semi-official actor list that helps validate legal names and service categories for smaller PSPs.
